component.name: KDE DJI Mic Mini Control
component.summary: KDE Plasma 6 System Tray, DUML USB Telemetry, Hardware Controller & Desktop Alert Daemon for DJI Mic Mini

description.p: KDE DJI Mic Mini Control provides a native KDE Plasma 6 / Kirigami 5-tab desktop control center, live system tray battery badge, real-time wireless transmitter VU meters, hardware setting toggles, USB/HID/DUML protocol inspector, and automatic desktop disconnection popup notifications for the DJI Mic Mini (2ca3:4011) on Linux.
Added official KDE Plasma 6 Flatpak package (org.kde.Platform//6.11) alongside native Linux archive.
Initial release of KDE DJI Mic Mini Control with DUML v1/v2 USB telemetry, system tray battery badge, and Kirigami 5-tab UI.
